title: Underground cities of Turkey

tellings.quote: This is quite a famous phenomenon in Turkey that there are huge cities. They look like ant farms on an enormous scale that are dug out under the earth.

plain: Turkey is said to have huge cities dug out under the ground that "look like ant farms on an enormous scale." The writer Graham Hancock, known for his books on lost ancient civilisations, describes them to Michels as "quite a famous phenomenon," without naming a source. He brings them up as a sign that people in the distant past had some strong reason to hide underground.
